actual_source_preflight.scope: Affected source tests and complete source/native/measurement/carry equivalence; unchanged inventory and schedule reused; no new anchor/cohort/structure/memory study

source_cost_projection.basis: Disjoint actual component CPU times multiplied by corresponding complete source/batch/cadence counts, with 1.5 margin. Maxima are empirical allowances, not theoretical runtime bounds. No whole-window fixed report is scaled by market-event rows.

exact_measurement_serialization.work_unit: one instrument atomic cell in the exact compressed measurement report

finalization_and_native_storage.work_unit: one native cell with its final measurement and exact storage

physical_address_and_selection.work_unit: one bounded physical reader batch of at most 65,536 rows

physical_batch_decode.work_unit: one bounded physical reader batch of at most 65,536 rows

selected_projection.work_unit: one represented raw-instrument batch of at most 65,536 selected rows

source_metadata_and_open.work_unit: one exact original source file in a requested interval

tail_event_storage.work_unit: one final partial event-file set per instrument/window

source_cost_projection.failure_output_cpu_reserve_basis: maximum observed exact Parquet write/read/hash CPU per serialized byte; separate fixed failure-output allowance
pending: Full anchor/rolling/causal-structure calculations, annual/date-block statistics and complete target matrices.

verified_component.raw_variant_policy: Every overlapping acquisition measured separately; complete ordered all-field equality compared; no inferred merge, economic deduplication or global supersession.
